comment: Careers pages. Starbucks frames employees as 'partners' and is benefits-forward (college, healthcare); a non-tech, mission-driven retailer — a useful out-of-sector case. Seed patterns; refine after `discover`.
comment_patterns: Refined after discover: `starbucks.com/career` (prefix) is a superset of /careers that also catches the 2010-2012 era; `careers.starbucks.com` covers the 2024+ subdomain. www/ and bare /careers were exact duplicates (CDX normalizes www) and were dropped. No early captures 2005-2007. Adjacent pages added via link expansion (M8): /responsibility (diversity, community, shared-values 2011-2020), /aboutus (2008-era csr/overview/partner-experience), about.starbucks.com (belonging/communities/foundation 2021+), stories.starbucks.com/stories/inclusion-diversity.
